model_questions.m1_under_keel_clearance: Can she safely transit the channel?
model_questions.m2_tidal_window: When is there enough water, and for how long?
model_questions.m3_turnaround_time: When does she berth, finish and leave?
model_questions.m4_eta_confidence: How certain is the arrival time?
model_questions.m6_jit_arrival: What does arriving just in time save?
model_questions.m7_port_craft: Are pilots, tugs and mooring gangs available?
model_questions.m8_risk_chain: What do today's disruptions do to the plan?

glossary.call_id: Our id for this vessel call (one row of the input sheet). Not a port system id.
glossary.imo: IMO number: the vessel's permanent hull id, unchanged across renames and reflagging.
glossary.voyage: The carrier's voyage number for this specific trip.
glossary.ata_ist: Actual Time of Arrival at the anchorage/pilot station, Indian Standard Time.
glossary.draft_m: How deep the loaded hull sits below the waterline, in metres. Drives every depth check.
glossary.loa_m: Length Overall. A berth shorter than this cannot take the vessel.
glossary.teu_total: Containers to move this call, in twenty-foot equivalent units. The main driver of TAT.
glossary.tide_m: Height of tide above chart datum at arrival. Adds directly to available water depth.
glossary.channel_depth_m: Charted depth of the approach channel before tide, siltation and dredging.
glossary.anchorage_queue: Vessels already waiting at anchorage when this one arrived.
glossary.berth_occupancy_pct: How full the terminal's berths were at arrival, percent.
glossary.net_ukc_m: Under-keel clearance after squat and the 1.0 m safety margin. This is the go/no-go number.
glossary.squat_m: Extra draft a moving hull gains from its own bow wave. Grows with the square of speed.
glossary.binding_reach: The channel section with the least clearance. It, not the shallowest section, sets the verdict.
glossary.min_tide_for_safe_m: Tide height at which this transit would become SAFE. Below it, wait for water.
glossary.max_safe_speed_kn: Fastest speed that still leaves a safe clearance, because slowing down cuts squat.
glossary.matches_sheet: Whether our verdict agrees with the DUKC_Status the sheet already recorded. A scoring check, never an input.
glossary.required_tide_m: Tide this vessel needs before the binding reach is passable.
glossary.usable_hours: Hours in the next 120 h during which the vessel could transit.
glossary.availability_pct: usable_hours as a share of the scan horizon.
glossary.longest_window_h: The single longest uninterrupted transit opportunity.
glossary.max_wait_h: Worst gap between windows -- the longest the vessel could be held waiting for tide.
glossary.next_window_start_ist: Start of the next usable window.
glossary.dredging_gain_h: Extra usable hours a +0.5 m dredge would buy. The investment case, in hours.
glossary.tat_hours: Turnaround time: arrival to departure, in hours. The headline prediction (p50).
glossary.tat_p10_hours: Optimistic end of the 80% band -- 10% of calls finish faster than this.
glossary.tat_p90_hours: Pessimistic end of the 80% band -- 90% of calls finish within it. Plan against this one.
glossary.etb_ist: Estimated Time of Berthing = arrival + waiting time.
glossary.etd_ist: Estimated Time of Departure = arrival + tat_hours.
glossary.wait_hours: Predicted wait between arrival and getting alongside.
glossary.berth_stay_hours: Time actually alongside working cargo = tat_hours - wait_hours.
glossary.confidence: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, from how wide the p10-p90 band came out.
glossary.engine: Which predictor produced the number: lightgbm, sklearn or the additive fallback.
glossary.top_drivers: The three input factors contributing most to this TAT, with their hours and share.
glossary.eta_p50_ist: Most likely arrival time from the current AIS fix.
glossary.eta_band_hours: Width of the p10-p90 arrival window. Wider means less certain.
glossary.sigma_hours: Standard deviation of the arrival estimate. Grows with forecast horizon and stale AIS.
glossary.assigned_berth: Berth the optimiser allocated, which may differ from the one requested.
glossary.berth_changed: True when the optimiser moved the vessel off its requested berth.
glossary.misses_tidal_window: True when the assigned start falls outside every usable tidal window.
glossary.algorithm: Solver that produced this assignment: cpsat (exact) or greedy (fallback).
glossary.reason: One sentence on why the optimiser chose this berth and start time.
glossary.recommended_speed_kn: Speed to arrive just in time instead of early. Lower speed, less fuel.
glossary.required_speed_kn: Speed needed to hit the target arrival exactly. Above the vessel's cap it is not achievable.
glossary.rta_ist: Requested Time of Arrival -- when the port actually wants the vessel, not when she can get there.
glossary.fuel_saved_t: Tonnes of bunker fuel saved by slow-steaming to the RTA instead of arriving early and waiting.
glossary.co2_saved_t: Tonnes of CO2 avoided, at 3.114 t CO2 per tonne of fuel.
glossary.anchorage_hours_saved: Hours of anchorage waiting removed by arriving just in time.
glossary.achievable: False when the vessel cannot reach the RTA even at full speed -- there is no saving to take.
glossary.movement: The berthing or unberthing manoeuvre this craft assignment serves.
glossary.pilots_tugs_mooring: Craft assigned to the movement: pilot / tug / mooring-gang ids.
glossary.shortfall: Craft the movement needed but could not be given. Empty means fully resourced.
glossary.response_gap_min: Minutes by which the nearest craft is late for the movement start.
glossary.resourced: True when every required craft was assigned on time.
glossary.system_confidence: 0-1 score for how much of the plan survives today's disruptions. 1.0 is undisturbed.
glossary.alert_level: NORMAL / WARNING / CRITICAL, from system_confidence and which rules fired.
glossary.tat_delay_h: Extra turnaround hours the causal chain attributes to the current disruptions.
glossary.root_causes: The exogenous conditions contributing most to the confidence drop, with their share.
glossary.disruptions: The conditions fed into the chain for this vessel, in plain words.
glossary.flags: Caveats attached to the row. TIDE_SYNTHETIC = tide was modelled, not measured. WAIT_IS_LOWER_BOUND = the wait was computed against this file only, so it under-states a real queue. QUEUE_DERIVED = anchorage queue was inferred from occupancy, not observed.
glossary.data_quality: Where each estimated input came from. MEASURED beats DERIVED beats SYNTHETIC.
